text: Finding people who are high agency and work with urgency... you can take on the world... they hear something from our customers... and they're already pushing on what the solution for them is... People just go and do it and solve the problem.
speaker: Logan Kilpatrick
context: Lenny asks Logan about what makes OpenAI able to ship products so quickly compared to his previous companies like Apple and NASA. Logan explains that the two most important characteristics they look for when hiring are high agency and urgency. High agency means employees can make decisions independently without needing consensus from many people, while urgency means they act quickly when they identify problems or opportunities.
text_ko: 높은 주도성(high agency)과 긴박감을 갖고 일하는 사람들을 찾으면 뭐든 해낼 수 있어요. 고객한테서 뭔가를 들으면 이미 그들에게 맞는 해결책을 찾아 밀어붙이고, 그냥 가서 실행해서 문제를 해결해요.
text_zh: 找对了既有主动性（high agency）、又有紧迫感（work with urgency）的人，你就能应付任何挑战。他们一听到客户有什么反馈，就马上去推动解决方案，大家直接上手，把问题解决掉。
text_es: Encontrar personas con alta iniciativa (high agency) que actúen con urgencia te permite comerte el mundo. Cuando escuchan algo de nuestros clientes ya están moviendo ficha para ver cuál es la solución; la gente simplemente se pone manos a la obra y lo soluciona.
key_sentence: People just go and do it and solve the problem.
original_text: I think finding people who are high agency and work with urgency, if I was hiring five people today, those are some of the top two characteristics that I would look for in people because you can take on the world if you have people who have high agency and not needing to get 50 people's different consensus. They hear something from our customers about a challenge that they're having, and they're already pushing on what the solution for them is and not waiting for all the other things to happen that... People just go and do it and solve the problem, and I love that.

vocabulary.definition: The capacity of an individual to act independently and make choices that influence outcomes effectively.
vocabulary.businessContext: In business settings, individuals with high agency are valued for their ability to take initiative, drive projects forward, and make impactful decisions without needing constant oversight.
vocabulary.nuance: This term often connotes a proactive and self-motivated approach, distinguishing individuals who are empowered to act from those who may rely heavily on direction.

vocabulary.definition: A sense of immediate importance or necessity that prompts swift action or decision-making.
vocabulary.businessContext: In a business environment, urgency is crucial for meeting deadlines, responding to market changes, and addressing customer needs promptly.
vocabulary.nuance: While urgency can drive productivity, it should be balanced with careful consideration to avoid hasty decisions that may lead to mistakes.

vocabulary.definition: To find a solution or answer to a specific issue or challenge.
vocabulary.businessContext: In the business world, the ability to solve problems is a critical skill, as it directly impacts operational efficiency and customer satisfaction.
vocabulary.nuance: This phrase emphasizes a results-oriented mindset, and while it is commonly used, it may be less effective when discussing complex issues that require nuanced approaches.

text: I think where you start to get into some of these very vertical applications... And I think a great example of this is actually Harvey.
speaker: Logan Kilpatrick
context: Lenny asks Logan how developers should think about building products that won't be disrupted by OpenAI in the future. Logan explains that OpenAI focuses on general reasoning capabilities rather than specific vertical applications. He uses Harvey, a legal AI company, as an example of how companies can build specialized tools for specific industries that OpenAI won't compete with directly.
text_ko: 제 생각에는 이런 정말 업종별로 특화된 애플리케이션(vertical applications) 쪽으로 들어가기 시작하는 지점이 있는 것 같아요. 그리고 그 좋은 예가 사실 Harvey예요.
text_zh: 我觉得当你开始接触到一些非常垂直的应用（vertical applications）时，Harvey其实就是个很好的例子。
text_es: Creo que al empezar a explorar algunas de estas aplicaciones muy verticales... Un gran ejemplo de ello es, en realidad, Harvey.
key_sentence: And I think a great example of this is actually Harvey.
original_text: I think where you start to get into some of these very vertical applications... And I think a great example of this is actually Harvey. I don't know if you've seen Harvey, but it's this legal AI use case where they're building custom models and tools to help lawyers and people at legal firms and stuff like that. And that's a great example of our models are probably never going to be as capable as some of the things that Harvey's doing because our goal and our mission is really to solve this very general use case and then people can do things like fine-tuning and build all their own custom UI and product features on top of that.

vocabulary.definition: Vertical applications are software solutions designed to meet the specific needs of a particular industry or market segment, rather than serving a broad range of sectors.
vocabulary.businessContext: In business and technology, vertical applications are often tailored to enhance efficiency and productivity within specialized fields such as healthcare, finance, or manufacturing.
vocabulary.nuance: The term is typically used to emphasize specialization and depth of functionality in contrast to horizontal applications, which serve a wider audience.

text: My whole position on this is prompt engineering is a very human thing. When we want to get some value out of a human, we do this prompt engineering. We try to effectively communicate with that human in order to get the best output.
speaker: Logan Kilpatrick
context: Lenny asks Logan to explain prompt engineering and give advice on writing better prompts for ChatGPT. Logan explains that prompt engineering exists because AI models, like humans, need context to give good responses. He draws an analogy between communicating effectively with humans and communicating with AI models - both require providing sufficient context to get valuable output.
text_ko: 제 생각은 프롬프트 엔지니어링(prompt engineering)은 아주 인간적인 일이에요. 사람에게서 어떤 가치를 끌어내고 싶을 때 우리는 바로 이런 프롬프트 엔지니어링을 하고, 최고의 결과를 얻으려면 그 사람과 효과적으로 소통하려고 노력해요.
text_zh: 我的看法是，提示工程(prompt engineering)本质上就是非常“人的”工作。当我们想从一个人那里获得价值时，实际上就是在做这种提示工程——要跟那个人有效沟通，才能拿到最好的产出。
text_es: Mi postura es que la ingeniería de prompts (prompt engineering) es algo muy humano. Cuando queremos obtener valor de una persona, practicamos esa ingeniería: intentamos comunicarnos con ella de la manera más clara y eficaz para conseguir el mejor resultado.
key_sentence: prompt engineering is a very human thing.
original_text: My whole position on this is prompt engineering is a very human thing. When we want to get some value out of a human, we do this prompt engineering. We try to effectively communicate with that human in order to get the best output. And the same thing is true of models. And I think it's like, again, because we're using a system that appears to be really smart, we assume that it has all this context, but it's really like imagine a human level intelligence but literally no context.

vocabulary.definition: In a manner that produces a desired result or outcome; efficiently and successfully achieving objectives.
vocabulary.businessContext: In business and tech environments, being effective often refers to the ability to achieve goals with minimal waste of resources, time, or effort, particularly in project management and communication.
vocabulary.nuance: While 'effectively' implies a successful outcome, it is important to ensure that the methods used are also ethical and sustainable.

vocabulary.definition: To convey information, thoughts, or feelings to others through spoken, written, or non-verbal means.
vocabulary.businessContext: Effective communication is vital in business for collaboration, negotiation, and relationship-building, often facilitated through meetings, emails, and presentations.
vocabulary.nuance: The term can imply not just the act of sending a message, but also ensuring that the message is understood by the recipient.

vocabulary.definition: The result or product produced by a process, system, or individual, often measured in terms of quantity or quality.
vocabulary.businessContext: In business, output can refer to the performance of employees, the production of goods, or the results of a project, and is often analyzed to improve efficiency and productivity.
vocabulary.nuance: Output can carry a quantitative connotation, but it can also refer to qualitative aspects such as creativity or innovation.

text: Context is the only thing that matters. It's such an important piece of getting a language model to do anything for you.
speaker: Logan Kilpatrick
context: Logan continues explaining prompt engineering best practices to Lenny. He emphasizes that the most critical factor in getting good results from AI models is providing adequate context. Logan suggests that if OpenAI made t-shirts, they should say 'Context is all you need' because context is so fundamental to effective AI interaction.
text_ko: 문맥(context)이 전부예요. 언어 모델(language model)에게 뭔가 시키려면 그 문맥이 정말 중요해요.
text_zh: 上下文是唯一重要的东西。想让语言模型(language model)帮你做任何事，这一点太关键了。
text_es: El contexto es lo único que realmente importa. Es clave para lograr que un modelo de lenguaje te funcione como necesitas.
key_sentence: Context is the only thing that matters for language models.

vocabulary.definition: Having significant value or meaning; worthy of attention or consideration.
vocabulary.businessContext: In a corporate environment, identifying important issues or tasks is crucial for prioritizing efforts and resources effectively.
vocabulary.nuance: While 'important' denotes significance, it may lack the urgency implied by terms like 'critical' or 'urgent.'

text: I think the thing that surprised me the most was just how quickly everybody got back to business.
speaker: Logan Kilpatrick
context: Lenny asks Logan about the dramatic weekend when OpenAI's board fired and then rehired CEO Sam Altman. Logan describes how the incident occurred during what was supposed to be the company's first major break since ChatGPT launched. He explains that what surprised him most was how quickly the team refocused on work after the crisis, demonstrating their commitment to OpenAI's mission.
text_ko: 가장 놀랐던 건 모두가 얼마나 빨리 다시 본업으로 돌아왔는지였어요.
text_zh: 我觉得最让我惊讶的是大家竟然这么快就回到正事上了。
text_es: Creo que lo que más me sorprendió fue lo rápido que todo el mundo se puso manos a la obra.
key_sentence: how quickly everybody got back to business.
original_text: I think the thing that surprised me the most was just how quickly everybody got back to business. I flew to San Francisco the next week after Thanksgiving, which I wasn't planning to do, to deal with the team in person and seeing, literally Monday morning, I was walking into the office being, like expecting, I don't know, something weird to be going on or happening. And really it was like people laser focused and back to work, and I think that speaks to the caliber of our team and everybody who's just so excited about building towards the mission that we're building towards.

vocabulary.definition: Experiencing a sudden feeling of wonder or astonishment due to an unexpected event or outcome.
vocabulary.businessContext: In business settings, being surprised can indicate a deviation from anticipated results, such as unexpected market trends or team performance.
vocabulary.nuance: While 'surprised' generally has a neutral connotation, it can imply a lack of preparedness or insight when used in a professional context.

vocabulary.definition: In a rapid manner; with speed or promptness.
vocabulary.businessContext: In the fast-paced world of business and technology, acting quickly is often essential for seizing opportunities and responding to market changes.
vocabulary.nuance: The term 'quickly' suggests efficiency and urgency, but overuse can imply haste without thorough consideration.

vocabulary.definition: Resumed regular activities or tasks after a disruption or interruption.
vocabulary.businessContext: This phrase is commonly used in professional environments to indicate a return to focus on work-related objectives following a break or unexpected event.
vocabulary.nuance: The phrase conveys a sense of professionalism and resilience, suggesting that distractions are managed effectively to maintain productivity.

text: I think 2024 is the year of multimodal AI, but it's also the year that people really push the boundaries of some of these new UX paradigms around AI.
speaker: Logan Kilpatrick
context: Lenny asks Logan about the most mind-blowing AI applications he's seen recently. Logan discusses new interfaces for AI interaction beyond traditional chatbots, mentioning products like the Rabbit R-1 and TL Draw. He explains that while chat is currently the dominant way people use AI, he's excited about new user experience paradigms that move beyond simple text-based interactions.
text_ko: 제 생각에는 2024년이 멀티모달 AI(multimodal AI)의 해인 것 같아요. 동시에 사람들이 이 새로운 AI 관련 UX 패러다임(UX paradigms)들 중 일부의 경계를 정말로 밀어붙이는 해이기도 해요.
text_zh: 我觉得2024年是多模态AI(multimodal AI)的元年，但同时也是大家真正开始突破AI用户体验(UX)新范式边界的一年。
text_es: Creo que el 2024 va a ser el año de la IA multimodal, pero también va a ser cuando la gente realmente se lance a explorar los límites de estos nuevos paradigmas de experiencia de usuario (UX paradigms) en torno a la IA.
key_sentence: 2024 will be the year of multimodal AI and pushing the boundaries of UX paradigms.

vocabulary.definition: To challenge the limits of what is currently accepted or possible, often leading to innovation or new ideas.
vocabulary.businessContext: In business and technology, this phrase is frequently used to describe efforts to innovate or develop new products and services that exceed existing standards or expectations.
vocabulary.nuance: This phrase carries a positive connotation, suggesting a proactive approach to growth and creativity, and is often used in discussions about innovation.

vocabulary.definition: Referring to the integration of multiple modes or methods of communication, interaction, or operation, often in technology or transportation.
vocabulary.businessContext: In the tech industry, multimodal systems enhance user experience by combining various forms of input and output, such as text, voice, and visual elements, to create more intuitive interfaces.
vocabulary.nuance: While commonly used in technology, the term can also apply to logistics and transportation, emphasizing the versatility and efficiency of using different modes.

vocabulary.definition: Established patterns or models of thinking, behavior, or practices that shape how individuals or organizations understand and approach a particular field.
vocabulary.businessContext: In business, paradigms influence strategic decision-making and can dictate the direction of innovation; shifting paradigms often lead to significant changes in industry practices.
vocabulary.nuance: The term often implies a deep-rooted belief system that may be resistant to change, making it a powerful concept in discussions about transformation and disruption.

text: I've got it. It's on a Post-It note that I... Right behind my camera and it's 'Measure in hundreds.' I love this idea of measuring things in hundreds, and it's for folks who are at the beginning of some journey.
speaker: Logan Kilpatrick
context: Lenny asks Logan about his favorite life motto during the lightning round. Logan shares his personal motto 'Measure in hundreds' which he keeps on a Post-It note behind his camera. He explains this philosophy helps people understand that success requires many attempts - if you think in terms of hundreds of tries, then failing five times means you've barely started, not that you should give up.
text_ko: 찾았어요. 포스트잇에 적어뒀는데 카메라 바로 뒤에 있어요. '백 단위로 측정하라(Measure in hundreds)'고 적혀 있어요. 저는 이런 '백 단위로 측정하기'라는 아이디어가 정말 마음에 들어요. 그리고 이건 이제 막 여정을 시작한 분들에게 좋은 방법이에요.
text_zh: 我记下来了，就贴在我相机后面的便利贴（Post-It）上，上面写着“按百来衡量”。我很喜欢把东西按百来衡量这个想法，特别适合刚起步的人。
text_es: Lo tengo. Está en un post-it que... justo detrás de mi cámara y dice "Mide en centenas". Me encanta esta idea de medir las cosas en centenas, y va dirigida a personas que están empezando un camino.
original_text: I've got it. It's on a Post-It note that I... Right behind my camera and it's 'Measure in hundreds.' I love this idea of measuring things in hundreds, and it's for folks who are at the beginning of some journey. I talk to people all the time, they're like, 'Yeah, I've tried this thing and it hasn't worked.' And if your mental model is to measure in hundreds, 'I measure in hundreds,' the five times that you failed at something, you failed and tried zero times.

vocabulary.definition: To ascertain the size, amount, or degree of something using a standard unit.
vocabulary.businessContext: In business, measuring performance metrics, such as sales growth or customer satisfaction, is crucial for evaluating success and making informed decisions.
vocabulary.nuance: While 'measure' can refer to any quantifiable assessment, it often implies a systematic approach to evaluation in a professional context.

vocabulary.definition: A process of personal or professional development that involves a series of experiences or changes.
vocabulary.businessContext: In a business context, a 'journey' often refers to the customer journey, which outlines the stages a customer goes through from awareness to purchase and beyond.
vocabulary.nuance: The term 'journey' conveys a sense of progression and transformation, making it more impactful than simply referring to a 'process.'

vocabulary.definition: The point in time or space at which something starts or originates.
vocabulary.businessContext: In business, the 'beginning' can refer to the startup phase of a company, where foundational strategies and goals are established.
vocabulary.nuance: The word 'beginning' often carries a sense of potential and opportunity, highlighting the importance of initial actions and decisions.

vocabulary.definition: A thought or suggestion as to a possible course of action or a concept that can be developed into a plan.
vocabulary.businessContext: In the business world, ideas are the foundation of innovation and strategy, often leading to new products, services, or improvements in processes.
vocabulary.nuance: The term 'idea' can imply creativity and originality, but it may also suggest a lack of concrete plans or implementation.
